relations.description: Sidelink transmission procedure requires NR sidelink communication operation conditions to be met
Procedure uses dedicated sidelink configuration from RRCReconfiguration
Procedure uses common sidelink configuration from SIB12
When T310 is running, UE uses exceptional transmission pool if available
When T311 is running, UE releases configured grants and may use random selection
When UE is in RRC_CONNECTED and uses dedicated frequency, it uses mode 1 allocation
Exceptional transmission pool enables random selection resource allocation
Normal selected transmission pool enables sensing-based resource allocation
When T304 is running, UE uses exceptional transmission pool if configured
